observation: Workspace validation found the already-failed v0.09.1 attempted frozen contract was itself invalid against frozen-release-contract-v2.schema.json because retry requirement REQ-0091-014 used field 'text' instead of required field 'description'.
preservation: The exact invalid attempted-contract bytes are preserved at versions/v0.09.1/FROZEN-RELEASE-CONTRACT.INVALID-ATTEMPT.json. The recognized FROZEN-RELEASE-CONTRACT.json path was quarantined because the freeze transaction had already been declared invalid under DEF-0091-001 and never became an eligible release contract.
root_cause: The freeze helper calculated a canonical hash but did not validate the candidate contract against the contract JSON Schema before writing it.
